cities: No store of its own in the US · independent shops, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned: Group-owned, not brand-owned: shirt factory at 700 Freeman St, Lafayette TN (address on brand's contact page; IAG About lists Measure Up Shirt Makers, Lafayette TN as its Tennessee factory). Sack suit/jackets cut and sewn at a 'sister factory' / tailoring house in Rochester NY (product pages). Gitman Vintage is a division of Gitman Bros., which Wikipedia says IAG owns. No photograph or filing seen.
craft_evidence.makers: Partly: product pages name Rochester NY (jackets, suit) but not the factory by company name; Lafayette TN named only on contact/FAQ pages, not on product pages. Shirts say only 'Made with love in the USA'.
craft_evidence.mills: Rare: Albini (Italy) on Albini Linen Flannel; Holland & Sherry (UK) on Sack Suit. Elsewhere 'partner mill' in Japan/Portugal/Peru unnamed. 2 of 14 pages read name a mill.
craft_evidence.madein: 14 of 14 pages read state country: 12 USA, 2 Peru (Roll Neck Sweater, Rugby Shirt). Fabric origin also stated (Portugal, Japan, Italy, China, USA). Contradicts about-page 'all our production based in the USA'.
craft_evidence.heritage: Dated and placed: Max Gitman founded Ashland Shirt & Pajama Company, Ashland PA, 1932; Gitman Bros. brand 1978; Gitman Vintage 'Launched in 2008' (about page). Lookbook page says 2009.
craft_evidence.process: Construction specs on shirt pages (18 stitches per inch, flat-felled seams, split yoke, extra-thick chalk buttons, lined placket, pre-washed/pre-shrunk, fabric weights/yarn counts e.g. 40s singles basketweave, 13 oz triple-ply canvas). No process narrative (no loom/dye/hand-work story) beyond specs.
craft_evidence.reasoning: Real, placeable making on the shirt core: USA-made, factory address published (Lafayette TN), parent group owns the plant and the 1932 Ashland lineage is dated and placed. Held at 4 not 5 because the brand itself owns nothing (it is a division of Gitman Bros./IAG), knits are made in Peru, jackets/suit in a sister Rochester factory, and mills are mostly unnamed. If Sebastian rules group ownership does not count, 3. Confidence medium.

ownership.owner: Division of Gitman Bros. (gitmanvintage.com FAQ/lookbook); Gitman Bros. owned by Individualized Apparel Group (IAG lists Gitman Bros. among its brands). Current Gitman Bros. president named in press (2020): Chris Olberding. No Gitman Vintage-specific owner statement.
